    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
    theme: cosmo
  pdf:
    toc: true
    documentclass: scrartcl
    papersize: a4
    geometry: margin=22mm

  data_dir: "."
---

```{r}
source('report_helpers.R')
b <- read_bundle(params$data_dir)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=7, fig.height=3.6)
emit_table <- function(x) {
  names(x) <- gsub('_',' ',names(x),fixed=TRUE)
  print(knitr::kable(x, digits=2, row.names=FALSE))
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat('**', b$cfg$title, '**\n\n', b$cfg$question, '\n\n', sep='')
cat('Geography: **', b$cfg$geography, '**. Reporting period: ',paste(b$cfg$years,collapse=' to '),
    '. Reference year: ', b$cfg$reference_year, '.\n\n',sep='')
cat('Snapshot: `',substr(b$manifest$snapshot_id,1,16),'`. Schema: ',b$manifest$schema_version,'.\n\n',sep='')
cat('Rates are calculated from exported counts and populations and may differ from published rates based on unrounded figures.\n\n')
cat('These are surveillance counts and estimates, not an estimate of all infections or a causal assessment of pandemic effects. Group comparisons use a fixed set of complete disease series and mandatory case notifications only.\n\n')
for(n in names(b$cfg$exclusion_notes)) cat('- ',n,': ',b$cfg$exclusion_notes[[n]],'\n',sep='')
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if(show_section(b,'headline')) {
  cat('\n## Headline changes\n\n')
  h <- headline_table(b)
  # Full identifiers remain in the companion CSV; short references fit printed pages.
  h$reference <- paste0('M',match(h$metric_id,b$metrics$metric_id))
  emit_table(h[,c('reference','subject','metric_type','value')])
  cat('\nChanges are percentages; a missing value indicates an undefined zero-baseline comparison.\n')
}
if(show_section(b,'group_index')) cat('\n## Viral and bacterial indices\n\n')
```

```{r}
if(show_section(b,'group_index')) plot_groups(b)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if(show_section(b,'group_totals')) {
  cat('\n## Group totals\n\n')
  x <- b$metrics[b$metrics$metric_type=='group_total' & grepl(':main$',b$metrics$subject),]
  emit_table(x[,c('subject','year','value')])
}
if(show_section(b,'small_multiples')) cat('\n## Disease trends\n\n')
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Calculated rates per 100,000. Horizontal axes show years; vertical axes show rates and vary between diseases."
if(show_section(b,'small_multiples')) plot_small_multiples(b)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if(show_section(b,'change_table')) {
  cat('\n## Change table\n\n')
  x <- change_table(b)
  x$reference <- paste0('M',match(x$metric_id,b$metrics$metric_id))
  emit_table(x[,c('reference','subject','metric_type','value')])
  cat('\nDescriptive changes are not statistical significance tests.\n')
}
if(show_section(b,'excluded')) {
  cat('\n## Dataset selection\n\n')
  x <- b$selection
  # Keep long exclusion reasons in a readable list for both PDF and HTML.
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(x))) cat('- **',x$topic[i],'** (',x$status[i],'): ',x$reason[i],'.\n',sep='')
}
if(show_section(b,'quality')) {
  cat('\n## Data quality\n\n')
  emit_table(as.data.frame(table(b$checks$status)))
  x <- b$checks[b$checks$status=='WARN',]
  if(nrow(x)) for(i in seq_len(nrow(x))) cat('- ',x$check[i],': ',x$detail[i],'\n',sep='')
  cat('\nSKIP means a check was not applicable or lacked compatible data, not that it passed.\n')
}
if(show_section(b,'sources')) {
  cat('\n## Sources and traceability\n\n')
  cat('Each chart point and number has a metric ID in `series.csv` or `metrics.csv`. `lineage.csv` links derived metrics to input metrics and raw records, including the population denominator. Raw record numbers are one-based CSV record positions including the header; they are not physical text line numbers for multiline CSV fields.\n\n')
  cat('The companion bundle contains full source and metadata SHA-256 hashes and the snapshot manifest. Keep the archived snapshot with the report to reproduce its values.\n\n')
  x <- b$sources[b$sources$status=='ok',]
  emit_table(x[,c('topic','publishing_date','used')])
  cat('\n### Printed metric references\n\n')
  ids <- unique(c(headline_table(b)$metric_id,change_table(b)$metric_id))
  refs <- paste0('M',match(ids,b$metrics$metric_id))
  n <- ceiling(length(ids)/2)
  length(ids) <- length(refs) <- n*2
  emit_table(data.frame(Ref=refs[seq_len(n)],Metric=ids[seq_len(n)],Ref2=refs[n+seq_len(n)],Metric2=ids[n+seq_len(n)]))
}
```
